statusLine.command: bash -c 'if ! git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "(not a git repo)"; exit 0; fi; branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown"); dirty=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); if [ "$dirty" -gt 0 ]; then echo "$branch · ✎$dirty"; else ahead=$(git rev-list --count main..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$ahead" -eq 0 ]; then if [ "$branch" = "main" ] || [ "$branch" = "HEAD" ]; then echo "$branch · ✓"; else echo "$branch · ✓ merged"; fi; else echo "$branch · ↑$ahead"; fi; fi'
